description: This file defines the LinuxPort class, a subclass of base.Port, for managing Linux-specific build and test configurations within a testing framework. It includes methods for determining the full port name, setting up dummy home directories, handling crash reports, and locating server binaries.

classes.name: LinuxPort
classes.description: A class representing Linux-specific configurations and operations for the testing framework, including build checks, crash report handling, and environment setup.

methods.name: determine_full_port_name
methods.description: Determines the full port name by appending the OS version if the port name ends with 'linux'.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LinuxPort instance, setting version, architecture, and optionally creating a dump reader for crash reports.

methods.name: additional_driver_flag
methods.description: Returns additional command-line flags for the driver, including crash reporter options if breakpad is enabled.

methods.name: check_build
methods.description: Checks if the build environment meets requirements; logs instructions if not.

methods.name: look_for_new_crash_logs
methods.description: Checks for new crash logs if breakpad is enabled.

methods.name: clobber_old_port_specific_results
methods.description: Removes old crash report results if breakpad is enabled.

methods.name: path_to_apache
methods.description: Locates the Apache server binary path.

methods.name: setup_test_run
methods.description: Prepares environment for test run, including creating a dummy home directory.

methods.name: clean_up_test_run
methods.description: Cleans up environment after test run, including removing dummy home directory.

methods.name: _setup_dummy_home_dir
methods.description: Creates a dummy home directory for testing purposes.

methods.name: _copy_files_to_dummy_home_dir
methods.description: Copies necessary files to the dummy home directory.

methods.name: _clean_up_dummy_home_dir
methods.description: Removes the dummy home directory and restores environment variables.

methods.name: _path_to_driver
methods.description: Constructs the path to the driver binary.
